purpose: Follow-up on broad exact-name sweep entries involving SGA/EGA, with special attention to public-tier clarity: SGA is a serious but caveat-heavy workpass/translation lane; EGA is source/OCR/community-TeX support rather than a comparable source-audited edition.

decisions.decision: Mostly older repair/audit/witness/restart packets from 2026-06-07 through 2026-06-13. They are valuable provenance and workpass aid, but they do not supersede the later 2026-06-26 SGA5 local status through p260-p265 already represented in public metadata. Antigravity-named candidate packages are not promoted.

Keep as serious support/audit material, not a completion claim. The sampled sga6_full_audit_v1 README reports 127 of 524 sampled source prose windows, about 24 percent, missing from current TeX in late regions. This confirms SGA6 is structurally substantial but compressed/thin in places and needs SGA5-style source-facing re-expansion.
Only the SGA7-I pp.001-050 restart payload was found in this exact-name slice. Treat as partial starter work, not SGA7 coverage.

The SGA_RESTART_20260607 control packet is a web-session handoff, not current public completion evidence. Its old coverage-summary wording that SGA5 was declared complete is superseded by later user/source-audit warnings and current p260-p265 workpass status. Cross-lane Deligne/Weber/idle/OCR packages caught by SGA-style naming are support artifacts for their own lanes.

The clean EGA package is defensible support material: NUMDAM scan PDFs, NUMDAM OAI metadata, and upstream/community ryankeleti/ega TeX. It deliberately excludes local AI drafts/OCR probes. NUMDAM OAI is metadata only, not body TeX; upstream TeX is real but incomplete, especially EGA III/IV and parts of EGA 0_IV. Do not present this as a source-audited AI edition.

representative_inspections.inspection: Restart packet instructs new web sessions to read failure modes, verify tools, build coverage table, continue SGA7-I from page 051, and never substitute screenshots. Its coverage summary is practical handoff state and explicitly says a new session must verify tranche by tranche against source scans.

Canonical cumulative French outputs only: SGA5/SGA6 TeX/PDF and SHA256s. README says no source-indexed/page-expanded audit PDF is included, and SGA6 is carried forward unchanged from repair025/repair021. Treat as cumulative artifact/backstop, not page-certified source audit.
Only five files: SGA5 cumulative French TeX/PDF, SGA6 cumulative French TeX/PDF, and SHA256 CSV. Useful compact cumulative snapshot but superseded by later SGA5 workpass/audit status.

README describes a text-side SGA6 audit with 21 numbering-hole candidates, zero diagram-word/no-display flags, and 127/524 sampled source prose windows missing from current TeX. It frames rows as locators, not verdicts; source scan decides.

Contains NUMDAM authoritative scan PDFs, NUMDAM OAI metadata, and clean upstream/community ryankeleti/ega TeX captured at commit 6498013f2b398d5a91013bd6883c6a880fa6f766. README explicitly excludes local AI drafts/OCR probes and warns NUMDAM OAI is metadata only, while upstream TeX is incomplete.

public_facing_caveats_to_keep: SGA5 is not complete; current public language should say page-local French workpass/source-audit through the stated cursor only.
SGA6 is substantial but compressed/thin in late regions; the 2026-06-11 audit found about 24 percent of sampled source prose windows missing from current TeX.
SGA7-I is only partial starter work unless a later specific package extends it.
EGA is support/stub/source lane: NUMDAM scans/OAI plus incomplete community TeX and partial drafts, not comparable to the SGA workpass lane.
Screenshot/diagram/image witnesses are aids only. Diagrams/tables must be reconstructed or left open.
next_actions: Do not loose-upload the old SGA repair/restart packets just because exact names were not in GitHub metadata.
Use the June 7 SGA restart payloads only as handoff/provenance if a new web session needs the old split upload set.
Before any SGA Zenodo refresh, prefer a compact current rollup with current cursor, caveats, source witnesses, and README rather than many older repair-aid ZIPs.
For EGA, if refreshing the record, front the clean source-support package as support only and clearly state upstream coverage gaps.
